title: Multi-Objective Optimization Under Uncertainty of Part Quality in Fused Filament Fabrication
abstract: arXiv:2608.18429v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This work presents a data-driven methodology for multi-objective optimization under uncertainty of process parameters in the fused filament fabrication (FFF) process. The proposed approach optimizes the process parameters with the objectives of minimizing the geometric inaccuracy and maximizing the filament bond quality of the manufactured part. First, experiments are conducted to collect data pertaining to the part quality. Then, Bayesian neural network (BNN) models are constructed to predict the geometric inaccuracy and bond quality as functions of the process parameters. The BNN model captures the model uncertainty caused by the lack of knowledge about model parameters (neuron weights) and the input variability due to the intrinsic randomness in the input parameters. translated_title: 熔丝制造中零件质量不确定性下的多目标优化
translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种数据驱动的方法，用于在熔丝制造（FFF）过程中进行工艺参数不确定性下的多目标优化。该方法以最小化制造零件的几何不准确性和最大化丝材粘结质量为目标，对工艺参数进行优化。首先，进行实验以收集有关零件质量的数据。然后，构建贝叶斯神经网络（BNN）模型，以预测几何不准确性和粘结质量作为工艺参数的函数。BNN模型捕获了由模型参数（神经元权重）知识不足引起的模型不确定性，以及由于输入参数内在随机性导致的输入变异性。利用这些模型的随机预测，研究了不同的基于鲁棒性的设计优化公式，其中诸如喷嘴等工艺参数...
tldr: 提出了一种基于贝叶斯神经网络的数据驱动方法，在熔丝制造过程中同时优化几何精度和粘结质量，并有效处理工艺参数的不确定性。
en_tdlr: A data-driven approach using Bayesian neural networks is proposed to simultaneously optimize geometric accuracy and bond quality in fused filament fabrication, while effectively handling process parameter uncertainty.
